reviews.how: The admitted Bootstrap core validates selected profile, exact Compose/role/private trust material, prepares signed images, inspects/reuses or starts only owned resources, and records the actual call result.
reviews.why: Its private operation hook follows successful preparation; owned Session cleanup and inherited role leases preserve cold/warm/concurrent behavior without PID adoption.
reviews.tradeoffs: Keep ordinary kernel command authority and future orchestration outside this launcher; broker absence is not proof that role leases are free.
reviews.additionalQualification: Keep the required native Linux/macOS/WSL, exact installed cold/warm/concurrent/recovery/frontend-exit and ten-second/refresh gates; do not mark them complete from this mapping.

reviews.how: The local owner loader checks the actual private enrollment/profile. The shared base mapper produces scoped L04 observations; pending output comes only from the retained admitted operation.
reviews.why: Running versions, persistence readiness and service counts require their actual owners and proofs. Pending output leaves kernel/persistence/work/hub facts unknown or unavailable.
reviews.tradeoffs: A current NATS starting observation differs from a historical OS receipt; same-UID code is trusted, and synchronous filesystem timing is not preemptible.
reviews.additionalQualification: Keep the required native Linux/macOS/WSL, exact installed cold/warm/concurrent/recovery/frontend-exit and ten-second/refresh gates; do not mark them complete from this mapping.

reviews.how: This private admission extracts only the fixed broker configuration and optional certificate/key from the complete allowlisted Compose object.
reviews.why: Exact config hashes, cert/key bytes, target names and 0400 UID/GID bindings prevent an otherwise valid profile from injecting different private files.
reviews.tradeoffs: Inline byte validation does not inspect Docker or authenticate a live server.
reviews.additionalQualification: Keep the required native Linux/macOS/WSL, exact installed cold/warm/concurrent/recovery/frontend-exit and ten-second/refresh gates; do not mark them complete from this mapping.

reviews.how: Three fixed owned-container file reads run together after broker identity admission; every command is canceled/joined before return.
reviews.why: The archive validator checks the private configuration, certificate and key hashes and bounds; errors return no successful subset or private bytes.
reviews.tradeoffs: Controlled-process tests are distinct from real injected 0400 files in the selected Docker engine.
reviews.additionalQualification: Keep the required native Linux/macOS/WSL, exact installed cold/warm/concurrent/recovery/frontend-exit and ten-second/refresh gates; do not mark them complete from this mapping.

reviews.how: Only three-or-fewer allowlisted independent version/engine/roster reads are batched under owned command contexts.
reviews.why: The first real failure cancels siblings and the caller joins all reads. Private stage labels explain which fixed read failed without exposing arguments or output.
reviews.tradeoffs: Mutations and private archives are excluded; faster inspection does not replace identity validation.
reviews.additionalQualification: Keep the required native Linux/macOS/WSL, exact installed cold/warm/concurrent/recovery/frontend-exit and ten-second/refresh gates; do not mark them complete from this mapping.

reviews.how: The selected Windows 29.8.0 client runs its bounded dial-stdio helper for one fixed GET /info request; strict HTTP/body framing yields only expected engine identity.
reviews.why: This repairs the qualified Windows interop read without daemon discovery, arbitrary requests or a new listener.
reviews.tradeoffs: The literal /info is an outbound private Docker protocol read, not an Agentmux HTTP route. Linux/macOS and other client versions require their own qualification.
reviews.additionalQualification: Keep the required native Linux/macOS/WSL, exact installed cold/warm/concurrent/recovery/frontend-exit and ten-second/refresh gates; do not mark them complete from this mapping.

reviews.how: Owned broker inspection first retains exact engine/container/image/port/volume/config checks and then verifies the fixed certificate/key archives.
reviews.why: TLS digests come from admitted enrollment rather than observed container data. Actual socket authentication remains a separate mandatory step.
reviews.tradeoffs: Docker inspection is not cryptographic peer authentication; archive fixtures do not qualify native/container injection.
reviews.additionalQualification: Keep the required native Linux/macOS/WSL, exact installed cold/warm/concurrent/recovery/frontend-exit and ten-second/refresh gates; do not mark them complete from this mapping.

reviews.how: The installed policy loader admits explicit OS owner/workspaces, private descriptor ancestry/ACL policy, external release, profile and bridge credentials; it prepares only the bound host image.
reviews.why: Ensure invocation IDs are real correlation values. Request/observe methods retain fixed enrolled server and subject choices without creating identities or discovering workspaces.
reviews.tradeoffs: Darwin protected executable and ACL/mount paths require native execution. Loader/component tests are not installed product boot proof.
reviews.additionalQualification: Keep the required native Linux/macOS/WSL, exact installed cold/warm/concurrent/recovery/frontend-exit and ten-second/refresh gates; do not mark them complete from this mapping.

reviews.how: The private binding copies admitted mutable configuration, re-reads full enrollment, then inspects the exact selected TLS broker before any credential-bearing dial.
reviews.why: An operation proof can be consumed once, only by its exact bounded comparable context and binding; mutations/expiry require another inspection.
reviews.tradeoffs: No caller callback asserts ownership. Absent/unavailable transport alone cannot authorize replacement of an independently leased runtime.
reviews.additionalQualification: Keep the required native Linux/macOS/WSL, exact installed cold/warm/concurrent/recovery/frontend-exit and ten-second/refresh gates; do not mark them complete from this mapping.

reviews.how: A held private profile root reads the fixed full-scope trust record and enrolled certificate/key and checks all hashes/pins/material bindings.
reviews.why: The returned fixed trust is not a caller-selected tls.Config. Policy copies retain external trust and prevent mutable slice/setting sharing.
reviews.tradeoffs: Reads neither renew certificates nor contact a server; privatefs supplements existing POSIX/ancestry rules and native Darwin controls remain separate.
reviews.additionalQualification: Keep the required native Linux/macOS/WSL, exact installed cold/warm/concurrent/recovery/frontend-exit and ten-second/refresh gates; do not mark them complete from this mapping.

reviews.how: The isolated HOST account carries fixed nonce/invocation/full-scope requests and authenticated L04 replies. Actual Run acquires its service lease and owns one Bootstrap call.
reviews.why: Its early service reports genuine pending state, transitions to actual completion, and cancels/joins exact startup/lifetime work before cleanup; request IDs and cold attempt IDs remain separate.
reviews.tradeoffs: NATS absent before entry cannot provide L04. Closed lifecycle receipts and synthetic completed-session fixture helpers do not replace current NATS status or kernel authority.
reviews.additionalQualification: Keep the required native Linux/macOS/WSL, exact installed cold/warm/concurrent/recovery/frontend-exit and ten-second/refresh gates; do not mark them complete from this mapping.

reviews.how: Fixed embedded authoritative schemas use closed bounded JSON and a deny-all external loader with bounded ECMAScript matching.
reviews.why: Request/reply/status shape checks reject unknown/case/duplicate/malformed values without fetching schemas or accepting caller validators.
reviews.tradeoffs: The schemas prove shape only; producer authentication, ACLs, actual scope and freshness remain in the owning transport/mapper.
reviews.additionalQualification: Keep the required native Linux/macOS/WSL, exact installed cold/warm/concurrent/recovery/frontend-exit and ten-second/refresh gates; do not mark them complete from this mapping.

reviews.how: Concrete runtime cleanup errors retain only the actual Session and service lease while resources are still pending.
reviews.why: The existing exact Group reaper notifies private completion and releases that lease; bounded retry and safe formatting preserve ownership without another waiter or PID adoption.
reviews.tradeoffs: Historical cleanup errors/all-reaped or closed file handles cannot create new cleanup authority.
reviews.additionalQualification: Keep the required native Linux/macOS/WSL, exact installed cold/warm/concurrent/recovery/frontend-exit and ten-second/refresh gates; do not mark them complete from this mapping.

reviews.how: Only a private actual completed cold-start probe matching scope, endpoint, broker/domain/stream/record sequence and age can mark write readiness.
reviews.why: Warm reads and stored records leave write readiness unknown; this helper never proves free capacity, replication or business readiness.
reviews.tradeoffs: Unit binding tests alone are not a real current persistence write.
reviews.additionalQualification: Keep the required native Linux/macOS/WSL, exact installed cold/warm/concurrent/recovery/frontend-exit and ten-second/refresh gates; do not mark them complete from this mapping.

reviews.how: A fixed safe error retains the exact localtls.Dialer when owned socket cleanup fails, and exposes its original cause through Unwrap.
reviews.why: Bridge/status callers close raw owned TLS before NATS closure, preserve failed cleanup facts and allow exact retry/peer EOF.
reviews.tradeoffs: No generic callback/closer, fresh lifetime, socket adoption or private cause formatting is exposed.
reviews.additionalQualification: Keep the required native Linux/macOS/WSL, exact installed cold/warm/concurrent/recovery/frontend-exit and ten-second/refresh gates; do not mark them complete from this mapping.

reviews.how: The service owner privately creates one operation from actual acquired lease/full configuration/cold attempt; only admitted core entry enables pending.
reviews.why: Immutable capability references and mutex-held mutable state preserve cancellation, one-shot completion, actual Session/cause and safe concurrent formatting.
reviews.tradeoffs: Private direct-enter tests are controls; only actual Run/core evidence proves real admission. Bounded cancellation joins supported filesystem work rather than discarding eventual ownership.
reviews.additionalQualification: Keep the required native Linux/macOS/WSL, exact installed cold/warm/concurrent/recovery/frontend-exit and ten-second/refresh gates; do not mark them complete from this mapping.

reviews.how: The installed policy re-loads current declarations and hashes exact typed OwnerEnrollment v1 with full scope, cold invocation and declared runtime image digest.
reviews.why: The parent held image digest is separately checked by runtime before passing its private writer descriptor to the newly spawned child.
reviews.tradeoffs: This native Go correlation encoding is not a signature, cross-language canonical encoding or live startup proof.
reviews.additionalQualification: Keep the required native Linux/macOS/WSL, exact installed cold/warm/concurrent/recovery/frontend-exit and ten-second/refresh gates; do not mark them complete from this mapping.

reviews.how: The installed factory completes both private policy loads and binding checks before adopting the inherited concrete writer.
reviews.why: Successful adoption transfers exact ownership to Run with no later factory failure; absent receipt plumbing preserves the normal server path.
reviews.tradeoffs: The presence of an environment variable or raw descriptor is not admission; no public caller callback or generic writer grant was added.
reviews.additionalQualification: Keep the required native Linux/macOS/WSL, exact installed cold/warm/concurrent/recovery/frontend-exit and ten-second/refresh gates; do not mark them complete from this mapping.

reviews.how: After actual entry, bounded fresh owner/profile revalidation and another pending check precede one historical control receipt outside the operation mutex.
reviews.why: Run closes the exact writer and preserves joined actual Bootstrap errors via a safe typed cause wrapper, including nil-Session cleanup retries.
reviews.tradeoffs: A departed frontend may break the pipe without canceling admitted startup. Accepted is historical entry, never current readiness; lock refusal is not proven contention.
reviews.additionalQualification: Keep the required native Linux/macOS/WSL, exact installed cold/warm/concurrent/recovery/frontend-exit and ten-second/refresh gates; do not mark them complete from this mapping.

reviews.how: Literal ensure/status/host commands load the explicit installed policy, ask authenticated NATS first, and start only a newly verified owned host for eligible unavailable ensure results.
reviews.why: The frontend deadline begins at entry. Genuine NATS starting can succeed; receipt fallback checks original cancellation/exact child exit and reports historical accepted/unconfirmed with instance state unknown.
reviews.tradeoffs: No child Stop on frontend exit, no report-PID adoption and no business/hub details are inferred from the receipt. Real installed timing/engine/native qualification remains separate.
reviews.additionalQualification: Keep the required native Linux/macOS/WSL, exact installed cold/warm/concurrent/recovery/frontend-exit and ten-second/refresh gates; do not mark them complete from this mapping.
